name: Security Incidents
blurb: Major AI security events as they are disclosed.

reading.body:
The most actionable fact in this data is that Lambda accounts for 62 of its 87 observed periods having at least one open incident, a rate that far exceeds every other provider tracked here.

The daily series runs from August 14 to August 31, 2026, and shows a clear step-down: counts of three and four incidents per day in the first half of the window drop toward zero by August 30 and 31. Whether that reflects genuine resolution, disclosure lag, or a change in what is being counted cannot be determined from the data alone. The series records incidents as they are disclosed, so recent dates are likely undercounts.

Across the six providers shown, the distribution is highly uneven. Lambda's incident rate, at roughly 71 percent of observed periods, sits well above Anthropic at around 3 percent and ElevenLabs at around 1 percent. OpenAI and Fireworks AI fall between those poles. Peak open incidents, a separate measure from frequency, reached three for Lambda and one for each of the others listed.

The data covers twelve providers in total but reports detail on only six. What drives Lambda's elevated rate, whether infrastructure, disclosure practice, or incident definition, is not explained here. There is no information on incident severity, duration, or downstream effect on compute availability. The connection to power, buildings, or grid capacity cannot be drawn from what is given.
